project.title: Jeju PixelFlip Pre
project.description: Prepared explorable pixel-art presentation prototype about Jeju Island.

pages.title: Jeju Overview
pages.summary: Opening 16:9 pixel-art atlas view of Jeju Island introducing the island as an explorable presentation world.
pages.speakerNotes: Frame Jeju as a compact but varied island. Explain that the audience will navigate prepared visual chapters through clickable regions rather than a standard linear slide stack.

pages.title: Spatial Structure
pages.summary: A geography-led page showing how Hallasan, coastal edges, east-west differences, and ring-road logic shape movement across Jeju.
pages.speakerNotes: Explain the mountain-centered structure of the island and why itinerary planning works best when the audience understands region clustering and travel time.

pages.title: Core Sight Map
pages.summary: Clustered visual map of Jeju's signature landscape, culture, and food experiences.
pages.speakerNotes: Use this page as the main branch hub. Show that Jeju's value comes from the network between scenic landmarks, food zones, and cultural textures.

pages.title: Recommended Routes
pages.summary: Main route-planning page that turns spatial understanding into itinerary logic.
pages.speakerNotes: Explain that Jeju rewards route design over checklist accumulation. Use this page to compare short-stay efficiency and slower multi-day exploration.

pages.title: Travel Advice Summary
pages.summary: Closing mainline page summarizing seasonality, pacing, logistics, and practical expectations.
pages.speakerNotes: Convert scenic inspiration into practical judgment. Close on the idea that Jeju becomes better when travelers match season, route, and pace thoughtfully.

pages.title: Hallasan
pages.summary: Deep dive into Hallasan as Jeju's central mountain anchor, trail world, and spatial reference point.
pages.speakerNotes: Describe Hallasan as the island's center in both map logic and emotional identity. Emphasize changing elevation, weather, and commitment level.

pages.title: Seongsan Ilchulbong
pages.summary: Deep dive into Jeju's iconic eastern volcanic cone and sunrise-facing coastal landmark.
pages.speakerNotes: Use the page to explain why Seongsan is so visually memorable and why it works as a strong eastern itinerary anchor.

pages.title: Udo
pages.summary: Deep dive into Udo as a smaller satellite-island experience defined by cycling, coastlines, and slower pacing.
pages.speakerNotes: Position Udo as a rhythm change that complements main-island sightseeing instead of competing with it.

pages.title: Jusangjeolli Cliffs
pages.summary: Deep dive into the basalt-column cliff formations that expose Jeju's volcanic geology at the coast.
pages.speakerNotes: Focus on shape, texture, and geology. This page should make volcanic history legible through visual structure.

pages.title: Waterfalls
pages.summary: Deep dive into Jeju's waterfall scenery, subtropical vegetation, and softer water-rich landscapes.
pages.speakerNotes: Use the page to show that Jeju is not only rocky coast and volcanic mass, but also lush and dramatic in a different register.

pages.title: Jeju Culture
pages.summary: Deep dive into cultural symbols, local materials, island identity, and recognizable everyday textures.
pages.speakerNotes: Keep the talk anchored in local symbols and environment rather than turning this page into a history lecture.

pages.title: Food
pages.summary: Deep dive into Jeju food experience through black pork, seafood, citrus, and dining atmosphere.
pages.speakerNotes: Present food as place experience and sensory memory, not as a long catalog of dishes.

pages.title: Dongmun Market
pages.summary: Deep dive into Dongmun Market as a dense urban node of food, produce, and local travel energy.
pages.speakerNotes: Use this page to contrast the island's natural scenery with a highly social, local, and practical urban scene.

pages.title: One-day Route
pages.summary: A disciplined one-day Jeju route scenario focused on a coherent geographic slice and manageable pace.
pages.speakerNotes: Be explicit about what is included and what is sacrificed. The value is clarity and enjoyment, not maximum stop count.

pages.title: Three-day Route
pages.summary: A balanced three-day itinerary combining scenic landmarks, food, culture, and travel pacing.
pages.speakerNotes: Show how three days allows a better mix of east, central, and urban/coastal experiences without constant rushing.

pages.title: Best Seasons
pages.summary: Seasonal guidance page showing how bloom, greenery, wind, weather, and crowd patterns change the Jeju experience.
pages.speakerNotes: Avoid claiming one perfect season. Explain that the best time depends on bloom, hiking, scenery preference, and tolerance for wind or crowds.

pages.title: Travel Tips
pages.summary: Practical advice page covering transport assumptions, weather, booking, walking expectations, and pacing.
pages.speakerNotes: Keep this page useful and concise. It should make the audience feel prepared rather than overloaded.
